data.long_meaning: One who provides for his family or community. The name Razzaq carries the meaning “The Provider” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Razzaq usually hope their child will grow to embody the provider and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who strive to be self-sufficient and provide for their loved ones
data.etymology: Razzaq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Provider.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Razzaq total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: رزاق
in_arabic.meaning: الرزاق اسم الله الحسنى، يقدم الرزق للجميع
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرزاق هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الذي يقدم الرزق للجميع، ويكفل رزق كل مخلوق. جاء في القرآن الكريم: 'وَيَرْزُقُ مِن يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ' (القرآن 3:37). يعتبر الرزاق من الأسماء التي تعبر عن عظيم قدرة الله تعالى ورحمته الواسعة.

in_urdu.name: رزاق
in_urdu.meaning: رزاق اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جو سب کا رزق فراہم کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رزاق اللہ کے ان ناموں میں سے ایک ہے جو سب کے لئے رزق کا انتظام کرتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کہ جو سب کو رزق دیتا ہے، اور کسی کو بھی رزق سے محروم نہیں کرتا۔ قرآن مجید میں اس کا ذکر ہے: 'وَيَرْزُقُ مِن يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ' (القرآن 3:37) ۔ مسلم tradition میں اس نام کو عظیم الشان اور رحمت کا اظہار کرنے والا مانا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रज़्ज़ाक़
in_hindi.meaning: रज़्ज़ाक़ अल्लाह का एक सुंदर नाम है, जो सबको रिज़्क देता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रज़्ज़ाक़ अल्लाह के उन नामों में से एक है जो सबके लिए रिज़्क का प्रबंध करता है। इसका अर्थ है जो सबको रिज़्क देता है, और किसी को भी रिज़्क से वंचित नहीं करता। कुरआन मजीद में इसका उल्लेख है: 'وَيَرْزُقُ مِن يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ' (कुरआन 3:37)। मुस्लिम परंपरा में इस नाम को महान और رحमत का प्रदर्शन करने वाला माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: رزاق
in_pashto.meaning: رزاق د الله يو ښکلی نوم دی، چی د ټولو رزق وړاندې کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: رزاق د الله د نومونو څخه يو دی چی د ټولو لپاره رزق رامینځته کوي. دا پدې مانا دی چی څوک ټولو ته رزق ورکوي، او هيڅوک د رزق څخه محروم نه کوي. قرآن کريم کې يې ذکر دی: 'وَيَرْزُقُ مِن يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ' (قرآن 3:37) . په مسلم دود کې دا نوم د لویو او رحمت ښودلو لپاره ګڼل کيږي.

in_english.name: Razzaq
in_english.meaning: The one who provides sustenance to all, a name of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Razzaq is one of the beautiful names of Allah, signifying the Provider of sustenance to all creation. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'R-Z-Q', it implies the act of providing or giving sustenance. The Quran mentions: 'And He provides for whom He wills without account' (Quran 3:37). In Islamic tradition, Razzaq is considered a name that reflects God's boundless mercy and provision for all beings, highlighting His power and benevolence.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: رزاق

data.cultural_impact: The name "Razzaq" holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic community as it is associated with the concept of selflessness, generosity, and the importance of providing for one's family and community. It is a reminder of the responsibility that each individual has towards their loved ones and their neighbor. This can be reflected in various aspects of Islamic society, such as the communal meals known as iftar during Ramadan, where people come together to share a meal and provide for one another.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Razzaq" lies in its connection to the concept of God as the ultimate "Razzaq," or provider. Muslims believe that all provision comes from Allah, and that it is a test of faith to trust in His provision. The name reminds us of the importance of gratitude and dependence on Allah for our daily needs. It is also a reminder of the moral obligation to help and provide for others as an act of devotion and service to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Provider" symbolizes One who provides for his family or community. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Razzaq serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the provider.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Razzaq was a title given to the caliphs who were responsible for the distribution of Zakat funds. This title originated during the early Islamic civilization, specifically during the time of the Rashidun Caliphs in the 7th century CE.
historical_references.context: Economic administration and distribution of Zakat funds

historical_references.reference: During the Ottoman Empire, Razzaq was the title given to the official charged with the collection of the land tax. This title persisted throughout the Ottoman period, from the late 13th century CE to the early 20th century.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Razzaq, which means 'The Provider' in Arabic, is commonly used as a title of respect for individuals who dedicate their lives to providing for others. In modern times, this name is seen on various platforms such as PayPal, JustGiving, and LaunchGood, where people set up fundraising campaigns under this name to collect donations for various causes, including disaster relief, education, and healthcare. This trend reflects the increasing importance of charitable giving and community service in contemporary society.
